name: Most_Magnificent_Model
description: Team 5's final model: Pray_For_The_Floor calibrated on 1998-2022 Senate races, plus candidate effects in the prior, in-cycle pollster house effects, national/regional/state simulation errors in points, longshot-corrected Kalshi at real weight, fresher national signals, measured RV shift, and retried Kalshi search.
